import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(r"\b(TMP|[a-p])\s*<-\s*(TMP|[a-p]|\d+)\b")

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    target, source = match.groups()
    values[target] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

names = [*map(chr, range(ord("a"), ord("p") + 1)), "TMP"]
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
